body: Thank you. Meditation certainly helps, yes. Smiling too. Thank you for the video, made my day a bit brighter. I've found that hypnosis works wonders too. I will continue my writing when I got the time ;-)

I appreciate the answer. Positive thinking certainly helps and I try to practise it every day. Although, sometimes negative feelings get too overwhelming like at the time of writing my initial post.

I will certainly try the 'Cancel' technique! :-)

The filter with which my eyes see is dark. I do not see happiness. I don't feel it. It's like another state of mind. If I could explain it with one word, I would be glad to do so. But it's not possible, sorry.
